matchupOfTheWeek.title: Run Defense vs. Rush Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our run defense grades in the 61st percentile against a unit that grades 6th — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here we sit at 1 PM ET on Sunday with a chance to right the ship after that Week 1 stumble, and frankly, the statistical universe is handing us a gift-wrapped opportunity: Pittsburgh's offense ranks 22nd in EPA while we're sitting 61st percentile in run defense against a Steelers rushing attack that grades out 6th—that's the widest real edge all week, and we'd be foolish not to lean into it. Drake Maye will need to navigate a Pittsburgh defense that sits 14th in EPA and has shown modest form (0.02 net EPA/play over their last three), which is hardly the murderous unit of Patriots-Steelers lore. The betting market likes us by 5.5 at home, and while recent history gives us pause—that 14-21 loss still stings—we've owned this matchup more often than not. A.J. Brown's absence will be felt, but if our front seven can make life miserable for that run game, this is a very winnable football game.
